name: plan-switch
title: Plan Switch
description: Switch billing periods to compare the monthly price, total and savings.
usage: <PlanSwitch options={["Monthly", "Yearly"]} prices={[{ monthly: 20, total: 20 }, { monthly: 15, total: 180 }]} />
useCases: On a pricing page, a buyer compares the monthly price with the annual total before subscribing.
At renewal, a customer changes the billing period. The app uses the selected index to send the corresponding plan to checkout.
task: Switch billing periods to compare the monthly price, total and savings.
behavior: Pair every options entry with a prices object at the same position. onChange returns the selected billing period index.
